title: ROG Xbox Ally Explained: Which Model Should You Get?
description: The ROG Xbox Ally and Ally X explained in plain English: what Xbox’s first handheld does, how the two models differ, and who should buy which one.
h1: ROG Xbox Ally explained: which model should you get?
intro: Xbox’s first proper handheld arrived in October 2025, built with ASUS. It comes in two versions that look almost identical but are very different inside, and very different in price.

image.alt: A wireless game controller lit by cyan and magenta neon light

cardText: Xbox’s first handheld, the two models, and who should buy which.

sections.html: The ROG Xbox Ally is a Windows 11 gaming PC shaped like a controller, with a 7-inch 1080p 120Hz screen. What makes it different from earlier Windows handhelds is the Xbox full-screen experience: it boots into a console-style Xbox interface instead of the Windows desktop, so it feels more like a games console. It plays your PC games from Xbox, Game Pass for PC, Steam and other stores.

Specs and launch prices are from launch coverage by Notebookcheck and HotHardware. Prices vary by country and retailer, so check today’s price.

The Ally X was widely praised for performance and comfortable grips, with Notebookcheck noting the Xbox interface is meant to make Windows easier to use on a handheld. The common catches: it’s expensive, and battery life in demanding games is short, as on most PC handhelds. A newer OLED version, the Ally X20, has since been announced at a higher price, according to Tom’s Guide.

• Get the Ally X if you want to play big new PC games on the go and the budget is there.
  • Get the standard Ally for lighter games and Game Pass, but compare it with a Steam Deck first.
  • Get a Switch 2 if you mostly want Nintendo games or a family console.

Compare them all in our handheld comparison or browse the gaming finder.

faqs.q: Is the ROG Xbox Ally an Xbox console?
faqs.a: No. It’s a Windows gaming PC with an Xbox-style interface. It plays PC games, including PC Game Pass, not Xbox console discs.
Yes. Because it runs Windows, you can install Steam and other PC game stores.
